items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: And Morris French was on the trombone... and Hande was on the sax... and myself on the band.

ctx.x: About how, when was that? You were born in 1913, you see?
Yeah, that was around about 1929 or 30 when it started. It started off. Then after I left them, then I started with Hande, John Hande. Yeah, remember who else?
Louisiana Shakers. Yeah, that was Louisiana Shakers.
